svg.title: A dependency view: what blocks what, across tickets and epics — SoftTrack web design mockup (#279)
svg.desc: Tickets can block each other and a card shows how many block it, and a chain can only be read one link at a time. A view of an epic or a sprint draws tickets as boxes and “blocks” as arrows, marks what is stuck and a blocker due after what it blocks, outlines the longest chain, and refuses a loop when the link is made.

svg.text: Done when an epic or a sprint can be viewed as its dependencies with work flowing one way, a ticket whose blocker is not done and a blocker due after what it blocks are marked,
the longest chain is highlighted, a loop is refused with a sentence that names its tickets, epics can depend on epics, sprint planning warns when a ticket is planned before its
blocker, and the same content is available as an ordered list.
